objectives: Rostow's stages of growth
Wallerstein's world-systems theory
Core-periphery model

sections.title: Economic Development Models
traps: Rostow (optimistic ladder): traditional → take-off → drive to maturity; Wallerstein (critical): core exploits periphery — FRQs ask you to critique both models.

title: Development Indicators
subtitle: Industrial and Economic Development
overview: Industrial and Economic Development 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: GNI per capita, HDI, GII
GDP vs. GNI distinction
Limitations of single indicators

sections.title: Development Indicators
traps: HDI combines income, education, and life expectancy — higher than GDP rank means good social programs (Cuba); lower means wealth without social investment (Gulf states).

title: Industrial Location Theory
subtitle: Industrial and Economic Development
overview: Industrial and Economic Development 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Weber's least-cost theory
Agglomeration and deglomeration
Footloose industries

sections.title: Industrial Location Theory
traps: Weber: locate at minimum transport cost for inputs + outputs; bulk-gaining industries locate near market; bulk-reducing industries locate near raw materials.

title: Globalization and Trade
subtitle: Industrial and Economic Development
overview: Industrial and Economic Development 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: New international division of labor
Commodity chains
Special economic zones

sections.title: Globalization and Trade
traps: Maquiladoras (Mexico–US border) are the canonical SEZ example — cheap labor, lax regulation, export-oriented; commodity chains trace production from raw material to consumer.

title: Sustainable Development
subtitle: Industrial and Economic Development
overview: Industrial and Economic Development 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Brundtland definition
Alternative energy and green technology
Microfinance and NGOs

sections.title: Sustainable Development
traps: Brundtland: 'meeting present needs without compromising future generations' ability to meet their own' — quote this definition exactly; FRQs love asking about it.

title: SOAPS and Context
subtitle: Rhetorical Situation
overview: Rhetorical Situation 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Speaker, Occasion, Audience, Purpose, Subject
Exigence
Constraints

sections.title: SOAPS and Context
traps: Exigence = the urgency or problem that prompted the text; students often confuse it with purpose — exigence is WHY it was written NOW, purpose is WHAT the writer wants to achieve.

title: Audience and Register
subtitle: Rhetorical Situation
overview: Rhetorical Situation 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Intended vs. unintended audience
Formal vs. informal register
Tone and audience relationship

sections.title: Audience and Register
traps: FRQ 2 (Rhetorical Analysis) always asks HOW choices affect the audience — never just label a device; explain the effect on the specific audience in context.

title: Purpose and Claim
subtitle: Rhetorical Situation
overview: Rhetorical Situation 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Informative, persuasive, narrative purposes
Thesis vs. claim
Implicit vs. explicit purpose

sections.title: Purpose and Claim
traps: A complex thesis acknowledges complexity or tension — 'while X, Y because Z' scores higher than a simple assertion; practice writing nuanced claims, not just pro/con.

title: Types of Claims
subtitle: Claims, Evidence, and Commentary
overview: Claims, Evidence, and Commentary 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Claims of fact, value, and policy
Thesis development
Arguable vs. factual claims

sections.title: Types of Claims
traps: Claims of policy argue 'should' — these require evidence for both the problem AND the solution; FRQ 3 (Argument) is almost always a policy claim.

title: Evidence Selection and Integration
subtitle: Claims, Evidence, and Commentary
overview: Claims, Evidence, and Commentary 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Anecdotal, statistical, and testimonial evidence
Embedding quotations
Source credibility

sections.title: Evidence Selection and Integration
traps: Evidence alone earns no points — commentary explaining HOW the evidence supports your claim is what differentiates a 4 from a 6 on the argument FRQ.

title: Counterargument and Concession
subtitle: Claims, Evidence, and Commentary
overview: Claims, Evidence, and Commentary 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Acknowledging opposing views
Concession-refutation structure
Straw man fallacy

sections.title: Counterargument and Concession
traps: Acknowledging a counterargument and then refuting or qualifying it shows sophistication — the 'complexity' point on the rubric requires engaging with tension, not ignoring it.

title: Logical Fallacies
subtitle: Claims, Evidence, and Commentary
overview: Claims, Evidence, and Commentary 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Ad hominem, false dichotomy, slippery slope
Hasty generalization
Appeal to tradition

sections.title: Logical Fallacies
traps: MCQ passages often contain deliberate fallacies — identify the specific name and explain why it undermines the argument's logic, not just 'it's wrong'.

title: Ethos: Credibility and Trust
subtitle: Rhetorical Appeals
overview: Rhetorical Appeals 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Establishing credibility
Shared values
Acknowledging limitations

sections.title: Ethos: Credibility and Trust
traps: Ethos isn't just about credentials — a writer builds ethos by conceding points fairly, using precise language, and demonstrating knowledge; look for all three in FRQ passages.

title: Logos: Logic and Evidence
subtitle: Rhetorical Appeals
overview: Rhetorical Appeals 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Inductive vs. deductive reasoning
Analogical reasoning
Data and statistics

sections.title: Logos: Logic and Evidence
traps: Logos questions ask about the STRUCTURE of the argument — inductive (specific → general) vs. deductive (general → specific); deductive is stronger if the premises are accepted.

title: Pathos: Emotional Connection
subtitle: Rhetorical Appeals
overview: Rhetorical Appeals 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Narrative and anecdote
Vivid diction and imagery
Shared values appeals

sections.title: Pathos: Emotional Connection
traps: Pathos is NOT manipulation — it becomes manipulative only when it substitutes for evidence; in rhetorical analysis, explain which emotion is triggered and why it's effective here.

title: Kairos and Timeliness
subtitle: Rhetorical Appeals
overview: Rhetorical Appeals 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Right moment for argument
Cultural context
Exigence connection

sections.title: Kairos and Timeliness
traps: Kairos = the opportune moment — King's 'Letter from Birmingham Jail' has high kairos because it responds directly to a published letter of criticism; timeliness strengthens ethos.

title: Syntax and Sentence Structure
subtitle: Rhetorical Devices and Style
overview: Rhetorical Devices and Style 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Periodic vs. cumulative sentences
Parallelism and anaphora
Fragments for effect

sections.title: Syntax and Sentence Structure
traps: Periodic sentence withholds the main clause until the end (creates suspense); cumulative adds details after main clause (builds picture) — both appear on MCQ with effect questions.

title: Diction and Tone
subtitle: Rhetorical Devices and Style
overview: Rhetorical Devices and Style 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Connotation vs. denotation
Abstract vs. concrete diction
Shifts in tone

sections.title: Diction and Tone
traps: Tone shift questions: identify the before-tone, after-tone, and the turning word/phrase that signals the shift — 'yet', 'however', 'but' often mark the pivot.

title: Figurative Language
subtitle: Rhetorical Devices and Style
overview: Rhetorical Devices and Style 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Metaphor and extended metaphor
Irony and satire
Hyperbole and understatement

sections.title: Figurative Language
traps: FRQ rhetorical analysis rarely rewards just naming 'metaphor' — explain what is being compared and how the comparison advances the author's argument or characterization.

title: Voice and Persona
subtitle: Rhetorical Devices and Style
overview: Rhetorical Devices and Style 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Authorial voice vs. persona
Formal vs. colloquial voice
Reliability of narrators

sections.title: Voice and Persona
traps: In synthesis and argument FRQs, your own voice matters — avoid passive constructions and hedging language like 'it could be argued'; be direct and assertive in your prose.

title: Reading and Annotating Sources
subtitle: Synthesis
overview: Synthesis 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Identifying source bias
Cross-referencing sources
Noting point of view

sections.title: Reading and Annotating Sources
traps: Synthesis FRQ requires using AT LEAST 3 of 6–7 provided sources — cite as (Source A) or (Source B); using 4+ sources distinguishes a 5 from a 6.

title: Building a Synthesis Argument
subtitle: Synthesis
overview: Synthesis 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Developing a central claim
Integrating sources into your argument
Avoiding summary

sections.title: Building a Synthesis Argument
traps: The most common synthesis mistake: summarizing each source in a separate paragraph instead of weaving them into your own argument — sources should support YOU, not the other way around.

title: Citation and Attribution
subtitle: Synthesis
overview: Synthesis 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: In-text citation conventions
Attributing vs. citing
Avoiding plagiarism

sections.title: Citation and Attribution
traps: You do NOT use MLA/APA format on the AP exam — simply write '(Source C)' or 'as the graph in Source D shows'; no bibliography required.

title: Crafting the Argument Essay
subtitle: Argument and Writing
overview: Argument and Writing 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Thesis with defensible claim
Line of reasoning
Evidence + commentary structure

sections.title: Crafting the Argument Essay
traps: The argument FRQ prompt gives you a statement to defend, challenge, or qualify — 'qualify' (agree with conditions) is the most sophisticated position and scores highest.

title: Organization and Transitions
subtitle: Argument and Writing
overview: Argument and Writing 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Body paragraph structure
Transitional logic
Coherence at essay level

sections.title: Organization and Transitions
traps: Each body paragraph needs its own mini-claim (not just a topic sentence) that connects back to the thesis — a paragraph about evidence with no claim earns no reasoning points.

title: Revision and Editing Strategies
subtitle: Argument and Writing
overview: Argument and Writing 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Recognizing wordiness
Strengthening weak claims
Checking evidence integration

sections.title: Revision and Editing Strategies
traps: MCQ grammar questions: eliminate passive voice, vague pronouns, and dangling modifiers — these are the three most tested editing issues on the multiple-choice section.

title: Narrative Structure and Plot
subtitle: Short Fiction
overview: Short Fiction 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Exposition, rising action, climax, falling action
In medias res
Frame narrative

sections.title: Narrative Structure and Plot
traps: FRQ 1 (prose analysis) focuses on HOW narrative choices create meaning — don't retell the plot; identify the specific structural choice and explain its effect.

title: Characterization
subtitle: Short Fiction
overview: Short Fiction 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Direct vs. indirect characterization
Static vs. dynamic characters
Foil characters

sections.title: Characterization
traps: Foil questions: explain what the contrasting character REVEALS about the protagonist — never describe the foil in isolation; always link back to the main character's traits.

title: Point of View
subtitle: Short Fiction
overview: Short Fiction 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: First person, limited third, omniscient
Unreliable narrator
Stream of consciousness

sections.title: Point of View
traps: Unreliable narrator questions appear on MCQ — look for internal contradictions, self-serving logic, or dramatic irony where readers know more than the narrator.

title: Setting and Atmosphere
subtitle: Short Fiction
overview: Short Fiction 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Physical setting as character
Pathetic fallacy
Setting as symbol

sections.title: Setting and Atmosphere
traps: Pathetic fallacy = nature reflects character's emotion (storm during grief) — FRQs ask how setting contributes to theme, not just describe what it looks like.

title: Symbol and Motif
subtitle: Short Fiction
overview: Short Fiction 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Symbols vs. motifs
Conventional vs. contextual symbols
Developing motifs

sections.title: Symbol and Motif
traps: A symbol must be earned by context — don't just call the color green 'hope'; trace how the text builds that symbolic meaning through repetition and contrast.

title: Poetic Structure and Form
subtitle: Poetry
overview: Poetry 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Sonnet forms (Petrarchan, Shakespearean)
Free verse vs. formal verse
Stanza structure

sections.title: Poetic Structure and Form
traps: Shakespearean sonnet: 3 quatrains + couplet; the volta (turn) often occurs at line 9 or in the couplet — FRQ poetry questions frequently ask about the effect of the volta.

title: Sound Devices
subtitle: Poetry
overview: Poetry 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Meter (iambic pentameter)
Alliteration, assonance, consonance
End rhyme vs. slant rhyme

sections.title: Sound Devices
traps: Scansion errors are common: 'iambic pentameter' = 5 iambs (da-DUM) per line = 10 syllables — a spondee (DUM-DUM) or pyrrhic substitution signals stress emphasis.

title: Imagery and Sensory Detail
subtitle: Poetry
overview: Poetry 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Visual, auditory, tactile imagery
Synesthesia
Imagism

sections.title: Imagery and Sensory Detail
traps: Imagery analysis: identify the sense, describe the specific image, then explain what emotional/thematic meaning it creates — three steps, not just one label.

title: Figurative Language in Poetry
subtitle: Poetry
overview: Poetry 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Personification and apostrophe
Conceit (extended metaphor)
Oxymoron and paradox

sections.title: Figurative Language in Poetry
traps: A conceit extends a metaphor throughout the poem (Donne's compass conceit) — FRQs ask you to trace HOW the comparison develops and WHERE it breaks down or complicates.

title: Tone and Speaker
subtitle: Poetry
overview: Poetry 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Identifying tone with precision
Speaker vs. poet
Tonal shifts

sections.title: Tone and Speaker
traps: Never say 'the poet feels' — say 'the speaker' or 'the narrator'; the speaker is a persona, not necessarily the author; FRQ graders deduct for conflating the two.

title: Theme and Meaning
subtitle: Poetry
overview: Poetry 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Thematic statement vs. topic
Universal vs. particular themes
Ambiguity and multiple readings

sections.title: Theme and Meaning
traps: Theme is a STATEMENT, not a word — not 'death' but 'confronting mortality forces recognition of what we value in life'; complexity comes from tension between competing themes.

title: Novel Structure
subtitle: Longer Fiction and Drama
overview: Longer Fiction and Drama 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Episodic vs. organic plots
Multiple narrators and perspectives
Circular vs. linear structure

sections.title: Novel Structure
traps: FRQ 3 (literary argument) asks you to choose your own text — prepare 3–4 complex novels deeply; breadth of novels matters less than depth of analysis.

title: Tragic and Comic Conventions
subtitle: Longer Fiction and Drama
overview: Longer Fiction and Drama 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Aristotelian tragedy (hamartia, catharsis)
Comic resolution vs. tragic endings
Tragicomedy

sections.title: Tragic and Comic Conventions
traps: Hamartia is a 'fatal flaw' — but in complex texts it's often a strength taken too far (Macbeth's ambition); FRQs reward this nuanced interpretation.

title: Motif and Thematic Development
subtitle: Longer Fiction and Drama
overview: Longer Fiction and Drama 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Recurring motifs across chapters
Thematic evolution
Subplots as thematic commentary

sections.title: Motif and Thematic Development
traps: Subplots often mirror or invert the main plot's theme — the Gloucester subplot in Lear mirrors Lear's blindness theme; FRQs give points for connecting subplot to main theme.

title: Social and Historical Context
subtitle: Longer Fiction and Drama
overview: Longer Fiction and Drama 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Reading through historical lens
Class, race, gender in literature
Authorial context vs. text

sections.title: Social and Historical Context
traps: Contextualize but don't reduce — a good FRQ argument uses historical context to illuminate the text's meaning, not to replace close reading with plot summary.

title: Crafting a Literary Thesis
subtitle: Literary Argument Writing
overview: Literary Argument Writing 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Interpretive claim
Tension and complexity in thesis
Avoiding plot summary

sections.title: Crafting a Literary Thesis
traps: Strongest literary thesis format: 'In [work], [author] uses [technique] to suggest [complex thematic claim]' — the claim must be ARGUABLE, not just observable.

title: Close Reading as Evidence
subtitle: Literary Argument Writing
overview: Literary Argument Writing 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Textual evidence selection
Quoting vs. paraphrasing
Embedding quotes with analysis

sections.title: Close Reading as Evidence
traps: Embed short quotes (4 words or fewer) mid-sentence with analysis — avoid block quotes; each quoted word should be earning its place by proving your specific claim.

title: Complexity and Sophistication
subtitle: Literary Argument Writing
overview: Literary Argument Writing 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Multiple interpretations
Qualifying the argument
Acknowledging ambiguity

sections.title: Complexity and Sophistication
traps: The '1 complexity point' on the rubric requires going beyond a simple claim — complicate your thesis by acknowledging where the text challenges or complicates your reading.

title: Paleolithic Art
subtitle: Global Prehistory
overview: Global Prehistory 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Venus of Willendorf
Cave paintings at Lascaux
Portable vs. fixed art

sections.title: Paleolithic Art
traps: Never say prehistoric art is 'primitive' — FRQ graders expect you to analyze formal qualities (line, form, scale) and propose MULTIPLE interpretations; certainty is penalized.

title: Neolithic and Megalithic Structures
subtitle: Global Prehistory
overview: Global Prehistory 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Stonehenge (function debates)
Skara Brae settlement
Transition to sedentary life

sections.title: Neolithic and Megalithic Structures
traps: Stonehenge is the key Neolithic image — analyze its post-and-lintel construction, astronomical alignment, and the limitations of interpreting function without written records.

title: Ancient Near East
subtitle: Ancient Mediterranean
overview: Ancient Mediterranean 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Standard of Ur
Stele of Hammurabi
Lamassu at Dur Sharrukin

sections.title: Ancient Near East
traps: Hierarchical scale = more important figures are larger — identify it in Mesopotamian reliefs; the Stele of Hammurabi uses it to show Hammurabi subordinate to Shamash.

title: Ancient Egypt
subtitle: Ancient Mediterranean
overview: Ancient Mediterranean 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Composite view (twisted perspective)
Ka and funerary function
Akhenaten's break with tradition

sections.title: Ancient Egypt
traps: Egyptian composite view: head in profile, eye frontal, shoulders frontal, hips/legs in profile — this is called 'twisted perspective' and appears on nearly every AP exam.

title: Ancient Greece: Archaic to Classical
subtitle: Ancient Mediterranean
overview: Ancient Mediterranean 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Kouros and kore figures
Contrapposto stance
Parthenon program

sections.title: Ancient Greece: Archaic to Classical
traps: Contrapposto (weight shift onto one leg) marks the Classical period — it appears in the Kritios Boy (transition) and fully in Polykleitos' Doryphoros; before this, Archaic figures are stiff.

title: Ancient Rome
subtitle: Ancient Mediterranean
overview: Ancient Mediterranean 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Veristic portraiture
Augustus of Prima Porta iconography
Pantheon engineering

sections.title: Ancient Rome
traps: Augustus of Prima Porta: identify cupid (divine lineage via Venus), Cupid riding dolphin (allusion to Julius Caesar), and the breastplate relief (diplomatic victory over Parthia) — all three make a complete analysis.

title: Byzantine and Early Christian Art
subtitle: Early Europe and Colonial Americas
overview: Early Europe and Colonial Americas 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Hierarchical scale in icons
Apse mosaics
Hagia Sophia

sections.title: Byzantine and Early Christian Art
traps: Gold background in Byzantine art = eternal divine realm, not a physical space — this is intentional abstraction, NOT a lack of skill; FRQs ask you to explain the theological function.

title: Romanesque Architecture
subtitle: Early Europe and Colonial Americas
overview: Early Europe and Colonial Americas 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Pilgrimage routes and church design
Barrel vault and thick walls
Tympanum sculpture

sections.title: Romanesque Architecture
traps: Romanesque churches have small windows (barrel vaults push outward, walls must be thick to resist) — this changes in Gothic with flying buttresses allowing large stained glass windows.

title: Gothic Architecture and Scholasticism
subtitle: Early Europe and Colonial Americas
overview: Early Europe and Colonial Americas 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Pointed arch, ribbed vault, flying buttress
Chartres Cathedral
Light as divine metaphor

sections.title: Gothic Architecture and Scholasticism
traps: The three Gothic innovations work together: ribbed vaults concentrate weight, flying buttresses transfer it outward, freeing walls for stained glass — explain the structural system, not just the parts.

title: Italian Proto-Renaissance
subtitle: Early Europe and Colonial Americas
overview: Early Europe and Colonial Americas 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Cimabue vs. Giotto (naturalism)
Arena Chapel narrative cycles
Illusionistic space

sections.title: Italian Proto-Renaissance
traps: Giotto's innovations: figures have weight and volume, express emotion, occupy believable space — compare to Cimabue's flatter, more stylized figures to show the shift toward naturalism.

title: Northern Renaissance
subtitle: Early Europe and Colonial Americas
overview: Early Europe and Colonial Americas 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Oil paint technique (Van Eyck)
Disguised symbolism
Arnolfini Portrait analysis

sections.title: Northern Renaissance
traps: Disguised symbolism in Northern Renaissance: everyday objects carry religious meaning (candle = divine presence, dog = fidelity, shoes removed = sacred ground) — Panofsky coined this term.

title: Italian High Renaissance
subtitle: Later Europe and Americas
overview: Later Europe and Americas 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Master Italian High Renaissance for the Later Europe and Americas unit.

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: sfumato and pyramidal composition
Sistine Chapel ceiling
School of Athens

traps: School of Athens: identify the central figures (Plato pointing up = ideal realm; Aristotle pointing down = physical world) — this encapsulates the Renaissance synthesis of Greek philosophy and Christian humanism.

title: Mannerism and Late Renaissance
subtitle: Later Europe and Americas
overview: Later Europe and Americas 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Elongated figures, anti-classical
Pontormo and Bronzino
Tension and artifice

sections.title: Mannerism and Late Renaissance
traps: Mannerism rejects High Renaissance balance — look for elongated necks/limbs, acidic colors, ambiguous space, and emotional tension; it's a response to the sack of Rome (1527).

title: Baroque: Drama and Motion
subtitle: Later Europe and Americas
overview: Later Europe and Americas 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Caravaggio's chiaroscuro
Bernini's sculpture
Dutch Golden Age painting

sections.title: Baroque: Drama and Motion
traps: Caravaggio's tenebrism (dramatic spotlight effect) is more extreme than chiaroscuro — FRQs distinguish these: chiaroscuro = gradual light/shadow; tenebrism = harsh, theatrical contrast.

title: Rococo and Neoclassicism
subtitle: Later Europe and Americas
overview: Later Europe and Americas 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Watteau's fêtes galantes
David's revolutionary art
Response to Baroque excess

sections.title: Rococo and Neoclassicism
traps: David's Oath of the Horatii (1784): the stark Neoclassical style (clean lines, Roman setting, sacrifice of individual for state) is a political statement before the Revolution — context drives meaning.

title: Romanticism and Realism
subtitle: Later Europe and Americas
overview: Later Europe and Americas 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Delacroix vs. Ingres (color vs. line)
Courbet and the working class
Photography's impact

sections.title: Romanticism and Realism
traps: Courbet's Realism was a political act — depicting peasants and workers as monumental subjects elevated their social status; this is always an FRQ-ready connection between style and ideology.

title: Impressionism and Post-Impressionism
subtitle: Global Contemporary
overview: Global Contemporary 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Monet and broken brushwork
Van Gogh's expressive color
Cézanne's geometric planes

sections.title: Impressionism and Post-Impressionism
traps: Cézanne's planes directly lead to Cubism (Picasso and Braque) — the AP exam rewards connecting movements across time; treat Post-Impressionism as the bridge to Modernism.

title: Modernism: Cubism to Abstract Expressionism
subtitle: Global Contemporary
overview: Global Contemporary 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Picasso's analytic Cubism
Surrealism and the unconscious
Pollock's action painting

sections.title: Modernism: Cubism to Abstract Expressionism
traps: Abstract Expressionism has two branches: gestural (Pollock, de Kooning — process and emotion) and color field (Rothko — contemplative, non-referential) — distinguish them in FRQs.

title: Contemporary Global Art
subtitle: Global Contemporary
overview: Global Contemporary 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Identity and postcolonial critique
Kara Walker, Ai Weiwei
Installation and conceptual art

sections.title: Contemporary Global Art
traps: Contemporary art analysis requires connecting form to concept — for Kara Walker, the silhouette form (historically genteel, decorative) is ironic given the violent content; the tension IS the meaning.

title: Pitch, Clefs, and the Staff
subtitle: Music Fundamentals
overview: Music Fundamentals 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Treble and bass clef notation
Ledger lines
Alto and tenor clef

sections.title: Pitch, Clefs, and the Staff
traps: Alto clef: middle C is on the MIDDLE line (3rd line) — students who only know treble and bass clef consistently misread alto clef; the sight-singing section uses all four.

title: Rhythm and Meter
subtitle: Music Fundamentals
overview: Music Fundamentals 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Simple vs. compound meter
Syncopation
Conducting patterns

sections.title: Rhythm and Meter
traps: In compound meter (6/8, 9/8, 12/8) the beat divides into THREE — the top number does NOT equal the number of beats; 6/8 has 2 beats (each divided into 3 eighth notes).

title: Scales and Key Signatures
subtitle: Music Fundamentals
overview: Music Fundamentals 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Major and minor scales
Circle of fifths
Relative and parallel minor

sections.title: Scales and Key Signatures
traps: Parallel minor starts on the same note (C major / C minor); relative minor shares the same key signature (C major / A minor) — these are NOT the same; FRQs test both.

title: Intervals
subtitle: Music Fundamentals
overview: Music Fundamentals 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Major, minor, perfect, augmented, diminished
Compound intervals
Inversion of intervals

sections.title: Intervals
traps: Interval inversion rule: quality flips (major↔minor, augmented↔diminished, perfect stays perfect) and number = 9 − original (M3 → m6) — always check both qualities on the written section.

title: Triads and Seventh Chords
subtitle: Chords and Harmony
overview: Chords and Harmony 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Major, minor, augmented, diminished triads
Dominant seventh (V7)
Leading tone seventh (vii°7)

sections.title: Triads and Seventh Chords
traps: vii°7 (fully diminished seventh) has four notes all a minor 3rd apart — all inversions sound identical; students must identify it by context (usually leads to I) not inversion alone.

title: Roman Numeral Analysis
subtitle: Chords and Harmony
overview: Chords and Harmony 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Figured bass symbols
Inversion notation

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: tonic, predominant, dominant

traps: Figured bass 6/4 = second inversion (5th in bass); 6 = first inversion (3rd in bass); root position has no number — common mistake is confusing 6/4 with the number of notes.

title: Voice Leading
subtitle: Chords and Harmony
overview: Chords and Harmony 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: SATB spacing rules
Parallel fifths and octaves (forbidden)
Contrary vs. similar motion

sections.title: Voice Leading
traps: Parallel 5ths and 8ths are the most-penalized errors on the SATB writing section — check every pair of adjacent voices, not just soprano and bass; inner voice parallels are equally wrong.

title: Harmonic Progressions
subtitle: Chords and Harmony
overview: Chords and Harmony 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Circle progression (IV–vii°–iii–vi–ii–V–I)
Cadence types (PAC, IAC, HC, DC)
Deceptive cadence

sections.title: Harmonic Progressions
traps: Perfect Authentic Cadence (PAC): V→I, both in root position, soprano ends on scale degree 1 — all three conditions must be met; missing any one makes it an Imperfect Authentic Cadence.

title: Melodic Writing and Contour
subtitle: Melody and Counterpoint
overview: Melody and Counterpoint 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Step vs. leap motion
Melodic climax
Sequence and motive

sections.title: Melodic Writing and Contour
traps: After a large leap, convention expects stepwise motion in the opposite direction — violating this without reason creates an awkward melody; FRQ melody writing is scored on this.

title: Species Counterpoint
subtitle: Melody and Counterpoint
overview: Melody and Counterpoint 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: First species (note-against-note)
Second species (2:1)
Consonance and dissonance rules

sections.title: Species Counterpoint
traps: First species allows only consonances (unison, 3rd, 5th, 6th, octave) — the 4th is dissonant in two-voice counterpoint even though it's 'perfect'; this surprises students every year.

title: Binary and Ternary Form
subtitle: Musical Form
overview: Musical Form 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Simple binary (AB)
Rounded binary (ABA')
Ternary (ABA)

sections.title: Binary and Ternary Form
traps: Rounded binary vs. ternary: in rounded binary the A' returns but is SHORTER (not a full restatement); in ternary ABA, the A section fully returns — this is the key distinction on MCQ.

title: Sonata Form
subtitle: Musical Form
overview: Musical Form 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Exposition (P, TR, S, Closing)
Development section
Recapitulation and coda

sections.title: Sonata Form
traps: In the recapitulation, the secondary theme (S) MUST return in the tonic key — this is the resolution of the tonal tension established in the exposition; missing this on an analysis FRQ loses key points.

title: Theme and Variations, Rondo
subtitle: Musical Form
overview: Musical Form 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Variation techniques (melodic, harmonic, rhythmic)
Rondo form (ABACABA)
Strophic song form

sections.title: Theme and Variations, Rondo
traps: Rondo theme (A) returns in the TONIC every time — contrasting episodes (B, C) often modulate; the return of A defines the form and is always the most recognizable section.

title: Secondary Dominants
subtitle: Chromatic Harmony and Modulation
overview: Chromatic Harmony and Modulation 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: V/V, V/IV, V7/V
Tonicization vs. modulation
Resolution expectations

sections.title: Secondary Dominants
traps: V/V = a dominant chord that resolves to the dominant of the home key — it's II# (raised supertonic) which is major; tonicization is a brief emphasis (1–2 chords), modulation is a full key change.

title: Modal Mixture (Borrowed Chords)
subtitle: Chromatic Harmony and Modulation
overview: Chromatic Harmony and Modulation 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Borrowing from parallel minor
iv in major key
bVII and bIII

sections.title: Modal Mixture (Borrowed Chords)
traps: The iv chord (minor iv) borrowed into a major key is the most common modal mixture — creates pathos; identify it by the flatted 6th scale degree in the bass or inner voice.

title: Augmented Sixth Chords
subtitle: Chromatic Harmony and Modulation
overview: Chromatic Harmony and Modulation 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Italian, French, and German augmented sixths
Voice leading to V
Resolution of the +6 interval

sections.title: Augmented Sixth Chords
traps: All augmented sixth chords expand outward to the octave (scale degree 5) — the +6 interval is between the flatted 6th (in bass) and the raised 4th; German Aug6 is most common and has 4 voices.

title: Modulation Techniques
subtitle: Chromatic Harmony and Modulation
overview: Chromatic Harmony and Modulation 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Common chord modulation (pivot chord)
Chromatic modulation
Enharmonic modulation

sections.title: Modulation Techniques
traps: Pivot chord modulation: find a chord that functions in BOTH the old and new key — label it with BOTH Roman numerals; the hardest part is identifying where the modulation has actually happened.

title: Solfège and Sight-Singing
subtitle: Sight-Singing and Ear Training
overview: Sight-Singing and Ear Training 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Moveable do vs. fixed do
Scale degree numbers
Sight-singing exam format

sections.title: Solfège and Sight-Singing
traps: The AP sight-singing section is recorded — you have 75 seconds to study, then sing; starting on the wrong pitch is an automatic penalty; establish your key firmly before you begin.

title: Melodic and Harmonic Dictation
subtitle: Sight-Singing and Ear Training
overview: Sight-Singing and Ear Training 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Error detection in dictation
Writing melodies from listening
Identifying chords by ear

sections.title: Melodic and Harmonic Dictation
traps: For dictation, listen for the cadence first — if it ends on V, it's a half cadence; identify the last few chords before filling in the middle; the ending is most reliably transcribed.

title: Family Structures Across Spanish-Speaking Cultures
subtitle: Families and Communities
overview: Families and Communities 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Nuclear vs. extended family norms
Compadrazgo (godparent system)
Urban vs. rural family life

sections.title: Family Structures Across Spanish-Speaking Cultures
traps: FRQ presentational writing: always integrate cultural comparison — 'In contrast to individualistic cultures, Hispanic family structures often emphasize collective responsibility (familismo)' earns cultural competency points.

title: Community Identity and Belonging
subtitle: Families and Communities
overview: Families and Communities 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.

Immigration and diaspora communities
Social media and community

sections.title: Community Identity and Belonging
traps: Interpersonal writing (email reply) must maintain a formal register (usted) unless the prompt specifies informal — switching registers incorrectly is a common language control error.

Social media usage patterns
Technology and language change

sections.title: Technology's Role in Daily Life
traps: Presentational speaking (cultural comparison): explicitly name TWO communities — your own and a Spanish-speaking one; vague references to 'Hispanic culture' without specifics lose scoring points.

title: Scientific Advances in the Spanish-Speaking World

overview: Science and Technology 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Environmental technology in Costa Rica
Medical research in Argentina
Innovation ecosystems

sections.title: Scientific Advances in the Spanish-Speaking World
traps: Integrated writing task: synthesize audio + print sources into your argument — you must reference BOTH sources explicitly; only using one source caps your score at the lower range.

title: Art and Artistic Expression

overview: Beauty and Aesthetics 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.

Frida Kahlo and identity
Contemporary Latin American art

sections.title: Art and Artistic Expression
traps: Know Diego Rivera and muralism as a cultural product of the Mexican Revolution — his murals were public art for the illiterate masses; this context appears in audio sources on the exam.

title: Fashion, Architecture, and Cultural Identity
subtitle: Beauty and Aesthetics
overview: Beauty and Aesthetics 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Regional dress and indigeneity
Colonial baroque architecture
Fashion as cultural statement

sections.title: Fashion, Architecture, and Cultural Identity
traps: Beauty and aesthetics questions often connect to cultural identity — Frida Kahlo's Tehuana dress was a political statement of Mexican nationalism; connecting aesthetics to politics earns insight points.

title: Rites of Passage
subtitle: Life, Death, and Transformation
overview: Life, Death, and Transformation 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Quinceañera tradition
Coming-of-age rituals across regions
Religious vs. secular ceremonies

sections.title: Rites of Passage
traps: Quinceañera combines Catholic tradition with indigenous rites of passage — FRQs ask you to explain why cultural practices persist in diaspora communities (identity preservation, family cohesion).

title: Death and Memory in Hispanic Culture
subtitle: Life, Death, and Transformation
overview: Life, Death, and Transformation 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Día de los Muertos vs. Halloween
Ancestor veneration
Death in literature (García Lorca)

sections.title: Death and Memory in Hispanic Culture
traps: Día de los Muertos comparison to Halloween: DdlM celebrates and invites ancestors back; Halloween wards off the dead — this contrast appears in comparative FRQs about cultural attitudes toward death.

title: Environmental Issues in Latin America
subtitle: Environmental, Political, and Social Challenges
overview: Environmental, Political, and Social Challenges 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Amazon deforestation
Costa Rica's ecotourism model
Water rights and indigenous communities

sections.title: Environmental Issues in Latin America
traps: Costa Rica is the canonical positive environmental example (80%+ renewable energy, ecotourism) — contrast it with Amazon deforestation for a balanced argument in presentational writing.

title: Immigration and Global Citizenship
subtitle: Environmental, Political, and Social Challenges
overview: Environmental, Political, and Social Challenges 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Push-pull factors in Latin America
Undocumented immigration debates
Bicultural identity

sections.title: Immigration and Global Citizenship
traps: Immigration FRQs are common — use precise vocabulary: migrante (migrant), inmigrante indocumentado (undocumented immigrant), ciudadanía (citizenship); lexical precision is scored.

title: Human Rights and Social Justice
subtitle: Environmental, Political, and Social Challenges
overview: Environmental, Political, and Social Challenges 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Movements for indigenous rights
Gender equality in Latin America
Economic inequality (Gini coefficient)

sections.title: Human Rights and Social Justice
traps: Presentational writing structure: thesis + 3 body paragraphs (problem, evidence, solution or comparison) + conclusion; timed at 55 minutes — spend 10 min reading sources, 5 min outlining, 40 min writing.

title: Spoken Communication: Interpersonal
subtitle: Language and Interpersonal Communication
overview: Language and Interpersonal Communication 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Simulated conversation format
Register (formal vs. informal)
Filler language and fluency

sections.title: Spoken Communication: Interpersonal
traps: Simulated conversation: you get 20 seconds to respond — use a filler opener (Bueno... / Mira... / La verdad es que...) while you organize your thought; silence loses fluency points.

title: Written Communication: Interpersonal and Presentational
subtitle: Language and Interpersonal Communication
overview: Language and Interpersonal Communication 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Email reply format
Salutation and closing conventions
Subjunctive in requests and opinions

sections.title: Written Communication: Interpersonal and Presentational
traps: Email reply must start with proper salutation and address ALL bullet points in the prompt — missing even one bullet drops you to the lower performance range regardless of language quality.

title: Advanced Grammar for Accuracy
subtitle: Language and Interpersonal Communication
overview: Language and Interpersonal Communication 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Subjunctive vs. indicative in complex sentences
Ser vs. estar nuances
Preterite vs. imperfect in narration

sections.title: Advanced Grammar for Accuracy
traps: Preterite = completed action with defined endpoint; imperfect = background, ongoing, or habitual — narrate a story in preterite but describe the setting/emotions in imperfect; mixing them up is the #1 grammar error scored on FRQs.

title: Why Cells Need Membranes
subtitle: Cell Biology
overview: Cell Biology 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Phospholipid bilayer structure
Selective permeability
Why compartmentalization enables specialization

sections.title: Why Cells Need Membranes
traps: Students describe the membrane as a wall — missing that it's a dynamic, selective filter; the hydrophobic core blocks charged/polar molecules but not small nonpolar ones like O2 and CO2

title: How Cells Move Substances Without Using Energy
subtitle: Cell Biology
overview: Cell Biology 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Simple diffusion vs. facilitated diffusion
Osmosis and tonicity
Concentration gradient as the driving force

sections.title: How Cells Move Substances Without Using Energy
traps: Students say water moves toward 'lower concentration' — water moves toward HIGHER solute concentration (lower water potential); confusing solute concentration with water concentration is the #1 osmosis error

title: When Cells Must Spend Energy to Move Things
subtitle: Cell Biology
overview: Cell Biology 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Active transport (Na+/K+ pump)
Endocytosis and exocytosis
Why cells maintain electrochemical gradients

sections.title: When Cells Must Spend Energy to Move Things
traps: Students treat active transport as simply 'moving against a gradient' without explaining WHY — the Na+/K+ pump moves 3 Na+ out and 2 K+ in per ATP, creating both concentration AND charge gradients

title: What Mitochondria Actually Do (Not Just 'Powerhouse')
subtitle: Cell Biology
overview: Cell Biology 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: ATP yield and where each stage occurs
Why oxygen is the final electron acceptor

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: glycolysis → Krebs → ETC

traps: Students memorize '36 ATP' without understanding that most ATP comes from the ETC (chemiosmosis), not Krebs — glycolysis produces only 2 net ATP; exam questions target WHERE in the cell each stage occurs

title: How Cells Capture Light Energy
subtitle: Cell Biology
overview: Cell Biology 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Light reactions (photosystem II → I, ATP and NADPH)
Calvin cycle (CO2 fixation, G3P output)
Why C4 and CAM plants do it differently

sections.title: How Cells Capture Light Energy
traps: Students think photosynthesis and respiration are opposites — they share intermediates (both use the ETC); students also confuse where O2 is produced (light reactions, from water splitting) vs. where CO2 is used (Calvin cycle)

title: How One Cell Becomes Two (and Why It Must Be Precise)
subtitle: Cell Biology
overview: Cell Biology 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Cell cycle phases and checkpoints
Cytokinesis differences in plant vs. animal cells

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: PMAT stages and chromosome behavior

traps: Students say 'chromosomes duplicate during mitosis' — DNA replication happens in S phase (interphase), BEFORE mitosis begins; during mitosis chromosomes condense and separate, not replicate

title: Why Meiosis Produces Variation, Not Just Gametes
subtitle: Cell Biology
overview: Cell Biology 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Crossing over in prophase I
Independent assortment at metaphase I
Comparing meiosis I vs. meiosis II outcomes

sections.title: Why Meiosis Produces Variation, Not Just Gametes
traps: Students confuse meiosis I and II: meiosis I separates HOMOLOGOUS chromosomes (reducing from 2n to n); meiosis II separates SISTER CHROMATIDS — meiosis II looks like mitosis but starts with haploid cells

title: How Cells Coordinate Their Own Death and Division
subtitle: Cell Biology
overview: Cell Biology 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Apoptosis as programmed cell death
Cancer as loss of checkpoint control
Proto-oncogenes vs. tumor suppressors

sections.title: How Cells Coordinate Their Own Death and Division
traps: Students say cancer is 'too much growth' without specifying the mechanism — cancer results from BOTH proto-oncogene activation (accelerator stuck on) AND tumor suppressor mutation (brakes cut); both must be explained

title: Why DNA's Shape Determines Its Function
subtitle: Genetics
overview: Genetics 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Nucleotide structure (sugar-phosphate backbone)
Why A-T has 2 H-bonds and G-C has 3

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: antiparallel strands, base pairing rules

traps: Students write DNA replication as symmetric — the leading strand is synthesized continuously, but the lagging strand requires Okazaki fragments because DNA polymerase only reads 3'→5' and builds 5'→3'

title: How DNA Becomes Protein (The Full Path)
subtitle: Genetics
overview: Genetics 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Post-translational modification and folding

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: promoter, mRNA synthesis, termination
codons, tRNA anticodons, ribosomes

traps: Students confuse template strand direction — the template strand is read 3'→5', so mRNA is synthesized 5'→3'; codon on mRNA and anticodon on tRNA are antiparallel, not identical

title: What Mutations Actually Do to a Protein
subtitle: Genetics
overview: Genetics 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Frameshift mutations from insertions/deletions
Why location of mutation matters more than type

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: silent, missense, nonsense

traps: Students think any mutation is harmful — silent mutations change the codon but not the amino acid (degeneracy of genetic code); a missense mutation in an active site is catastrophic, but in a non-functional region may be neutral

title: Predicting Offspring Traits the Right Way
subtitle: Genetics
overview: Genetics 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Monohybrid and dihybrid crosses
Test cross logic

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: segregation and independent assortment

traps: Students apply independent assortment to genes on the SAME chromosome — linked genes violate independent assortment; crossing over can separate linked genes, but they're not inherited at the expected 9:3:3:1 ratio

title: When Simple Dominance Doesn't Apply
subtitle: Genetics
overview: Genetics 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Incomplete dominance vs. codominance
Multiple alleles (ABO blood type)
Pleiotropy and polygenic traits

sections.title: When Simple Dominance Doesn't Apply
traps: Students treat codominance and incomplete dominance as the same — codominance: BOTH phenotypes fully expressed (AB blood type shows both A and B); incomplete dominance: a BLEND (red + white = pink); these produce different phenotypes

title: Why Sex-Linked Traits Skip Generations
subtitle: Genetics
overview: Genetics 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: X-linked inheritance patterns
Why males are hemizygous
Carrier females and affected males ratio

sections.title: Why Sex-Linked Traits Skip Generations
traps: Students think X-linked traits only affect males — carrier females (X^A X^a) are unaffected but pass the allele to 50% of sons; X-linked dominant traits affect females MORE because they have two X chromosomes

title: How Gene Expression Is Turned On and Off
subtitle: Genetics
overview: Genetics 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Master How Gene Expression Is Turned On and Off for the Genetics unit.

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: inducible gene regulation
repressible gene regulation
enhancers and silencers

traps: Students flip lac operon logic — lactose REMOVES the repressor (induces transcription); when glucose is absent AND lactose is present, transcription is maximal; students miss that both conditions must be met for full expression

title: Biotechnology: How We Read and Edit DNA
subtitle: Genetics
overview: Genetics 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: PCR, gel electrophoresis, CRISPR basics
Restriction enzymes and recombinant DNA
Ethical considerations in genetic engineering

sections.title: Biotechnology: How We Read and Edit DNA
traps: Students say gel electrophoresis separates by 'size' — smaller fragments move FARTHER from the well (toward positive end); students reverse this, placing large bands at the bottom instead of the top

title: What Darwin Actually Argued (and What He Didn't)
subtitle: Evolution
overview: Evolution 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Fitness as reproductive success, not strength
Common descent vs. progressive evolution myth

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: variation, heritability, differential reproduction

traps: Students say organisms 'adapt' intentionally — natural selection acts on existing HERITABLE variation, not on need; an organism cannot generate a useful mutation because it needs one

title: The Evidence That Species Change Over Time
subtitle: Evolution
overview: Evolution 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Fossil record and transitional forms
Homologous, analogous, and vestigial structures

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: DNA comparison and cytochrome c

traps: Students confuse homologous and analogous structures — homologous structures share COMMON ANCESTRY (bat wing/human arm = same bones, different function); analogous structures share FUNCTION but NOT ancestry (bat wing/butterfly wing)

title: How Populations Evolve (Not Individuals)
subtitle: Evolution
overview: Evolution 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium and five conditions
Allele frequency shifts as evolution
p² + 2pq + q² = 1 application

sections.title: How Populations Evolve (Not Individuals)
traps: Students calculate p and q correctly but misidentify which genotype frequency they need — q² = frequency of homozygous recessive; q = √(q²), then p = 1 - q; always start with q² from the given phenotype data

title: Mechanisms That Change Allele Frequencies
subtitle: Evolution
overview: Evolution 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Genetic drift (bottleneck and founder effects)
Gene flow and mutation as evolutionary forces

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: directional, stabilizing, disruptive

traps: Students rank natural selection as the strongest evolutionary force — in small populations, GENETIC DRIFT can overpower selection, fixing harmful alleles by chance; the bottleneck effect is a common FRQ setup

title: How New Species Form
subtitle: Evolution
overview: Evolution 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Allopatric vs. sympatric speciation
Reproductive isolation mechanisms (pre- and postzygotic)
Gradualism vs. punctuated equilibrium

sections.title: How New Species Form
traps: Students say geographic isolation = speciation — geographic isolation leads to genetic divergence, but speciation only occurs when REPRODUCTIVE ISOLATION develops; you can have allopatric populations that can still interbreed

title: Reading the Tree of Life
subtitle: Evolution
overview: Evolution 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Cladograms and shared derived characters
Monophyletic vs. paraphyletic groups
How to determine most recent common ancestor

sections.title: Reading the Tree of Life
traps: Students read cladograms by looking at branch tips rather than branching points — the most recent common ancestor is found at the NODE where two lineages diverge, not at a tip; outgroup roots the tree

title: Why Energy Is Lost at Every Trophic Level
subtitle: Ecology
overview: Ecology 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: 10% rule and energy pyramids
Biomass vs. energy vs. number pyramids
Why food chains rarely exceed 4–5 levels

sections.title: Why Energy Is Lost at Every Trophic Level
traps: Students invert pyramid of biomass in aquatic ecosystems — in open ocean, phytoplankton (producers) have LOWER biomass than zooplankton because phytoplankton reproduce so fast; inverted biomass pyramids are a recurring trick question

title: How Nutrients Cycle While Energy Flows One Way
subtitle: Ecology
overview: Ecology 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Phosphorus cycle and eutrophication

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: key reservoirs and fluxes
fixation, nitrification, denitrification

traps: Students say nitrogen fixation is done by plants — only certain bacteria (Rhizobium in root nodules, free-living Azotobacter) fix N2 into NH3; plants absorb fixed nitrogen as NO3- or NH4+, they cannot fix it themselves

title: How Population Size Is Controlled
subtitle: Ecology
overview: Ecology 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Density-dependent vs. density-independent factors
Logistic growth and carrying capacity (K)
r-strategists vs. K-strategists

sections.title: How Population Size Is Controlled
traps: Students confuse the J-curve and S-curve — J-curve = exponential growth (no resource limits); S-curve = logistic growth (slows as population approaches K); the inflection point of the S-curve is at K/2, where growth rate is maximum

title: Species Interactions: Who Wins and Who Loses
subtitle: Ecology
overview: Ecology 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Competition, predation, mutualism, commensalism, parasitism
Predator-prey cycles (Lotka-Volterra)
Coevolution and arms races

sections.title: Species Interactions: Who Wins and Who Loses
traps: Students describe commensalism as 'both benefit slightly' — commensalism is (+/0): one benefits, the other is UNAFFECTED; mutualism is (+/+); students must be precise about the 0 in commensalism

title: How Ecosystems Recover and Change Over Time
subtitle: Ecology
overview: Ecology 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Primary vs. secondary succession
Pioneer species and climax communities
Keystone species and ecosystem engineers

sections.title: How Ecosystems Recover and Change Over Time
traps: Students say the climax community is permanent — disturbance ecology shows ecosystems are dynamic; fire-adapted communities (chaparral) REQUIRE periodic disturbance to maintain their climax state; no ecosystem is truly at equilibrium

title: Biodiversity: Why It Matters and What Threatens It
subtitle: Ecology
overview: Ecology 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Species richness vs. evenness
Habitat fragmentation and edge effects

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: area and isolation effects

traps: Students treat species richness as the only measure of biodiversity — an ecosystem with 100 species all at equal abundance (high evenness) is more diverse than one where 1 species dominates 90%; both dimensions matter

title: How the Nervous System Processes and Responds
subtitle: Human Biology
overview: Human Biology 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Synapse transmission and neurotransmitters
CNS vs. PNS organization

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: resting, depolarization, repolarization

traps: Students say sodium rushes IN to repolarize — sodium rushes in to DEPOLARIZE; potassium rushes OUT to repolarize; the Na+/K+ pump then restores resting potential; these three steps are all distinct and frequently tested separately

title: How Hormones Control the Body's Long-Term Responses
subtitle: Human Biology
overview: Human Biology 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Endocrine vs. nervous system comparison
Hypothalamus-pituitary axis (HPaxis)

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: negative vs. positive

traps: Students confuse positive and negative feedback — negative feedback RESISTS change and maintains homeostasis (thermoregulation, blood glucose); positive feedback AMPLIFIES a change to completion (childbirth contractions, blood clotting)

title: How the Immune System Distinguishes Self from Non-Self
subtitle: Human Biology
overview: Human Biology 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Innate vs. adaptive immunity
B cells (antibodies) and T cells (cell-mediated)
Memory cells and vaccination logic

sections.title: How the Immune System Distinguishes Self from Non-Self
traps: Students say antibodies kill pathogens directly — antibodies FLAG antigens for destruction (opsonization) but do not kill; cytotoxic T cells directly kill infected cells; these are separate arms of adaptive immunity

title: How the Heart and Lungs Work as a Single System
subtitle: Human Biology
overview: Human Biology 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Pulmonary vs. systemic circulation

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: systole, diastole, AV/SL valves
diffusion driving forces

traps: Students say deoxygenated blood is blue — blood is always red (oxyhemoglobin = bright red, deoxyhemoglobin = dark red); the blue appearance of veins is due to light absorption through skin, not the blood color

title: How the Body Regulates Water and Waste
subtitle: Human Biology
overview: Human Biology 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: ADH and aldosterone in water balance
Loop of Henle countercurrent multiplication

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: filtration, reabsorption, secretion

traps: Students say the kidney filters and then excretes everything filtered — 99% of filtered water and most solutes are REABSORBED; only a small fraction becomes urine; the nephron is primarily a recovery system, not an excretion system

title: Human Reproduction and Embryonic Development
subtitle: Human Biology
overview: Human Biology 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Fertilization through implantation
Embryonic stem cells and differentiation

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: spermatogenesis vs. oogenesis

traps: Students think oogenesis and spermatogenesis are parallel — spermatogenesis produces 4 functional sperm per meiosis; oogenesis produces 1 egg + 3 polar bodies per meiosis; unequal cytokinesis concentrates cytoplasm in the egg

title: Why Atoms Are Mostly Empty Space (And What That Means)
subtitle: Atomic Structure
overview: Atomic Structure 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Rutherford's nuclear model vs. Thomson's plum pudding
Nuclear charge as the identity of an element

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: location and mass

traps: Students write atomic number = number of neutrons — atomic number = number of PROTONS; neutrons = mass number − atomic number; this error cascades into every electron configuration question

title: Why Electrons Exist in Energy Levels, Not Orbits
subtitle: Atomic Structure
overview: Atomic Structure 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Bohr model limitations

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: orbitals as probability clouds
n, l, ml, ms

traps: Students write electron configurations by memorizing '1s 2s 2p...' without applying the Aufbau diagonal rule — the 4s orbital fills BEFORE 3d (lower energy), but 3d is listed before 4s in orbital notation

title: How Electron Configuration Predicts Periodic Trends
subtitle: Atomic Structure
overview: Atomic Structure 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Ionization energy, atomic radius, electronegativity trends
Effective nuclear charge (Zeff)
Why trends reverse at filled/half-filled subshells

sections.title: How Electron Configuration Predicts Periodic Trends
traps: Students say 'ionization energy always increases across a period' — IE dips at group 3 (2p¹ has higher energy than 2s²) and at group 6 (pairing in 2p⁴ causes repulsion, easier to remove); oxygen has LOWER IE than nitrogen

title: What Isotopes and Atomic Mass Really Tell Us
subtitle: Atomic Structure
overview: Atomic Structure 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Calculating weighted average atomic mass
Mass spectrometry and abundance

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: same protons, different neutrons

traps: Students round atomic mass to find neutron count — atomic mass on the periodic table is a WEIGHTED AVERAGE, not the mass of any single atom; use the most abundant isotope's mass number to find neutrons

title: How Light and Matter Exchange Energy
subtitle: Atomic Structure
overview: Atomic Structure 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Electromagnetic spectrum and energy-frequency-wavelength (E=hν)
Emission spectra as electron fingerprints

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: photon particle model of light

traps: Students use E = hν with wavelength instead of frequency — E is proportional to FREQUENCY (ν), inversely proportional to wavelength (λ); high frequency = high energy = short wavelength; UV has MORE energy than infrared

title: Why Metals Give Away Electrons and What That Creates
subtitle: Chemical Bonding
overview: Chemical Bonding 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Cation vs. anion formation logic

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: electron transfer and lattice energy
charge and size

traps: Students confuse ionic bond strength with electronegativity difference — lattice energy (ionic bond strength) depends on ION CHARGE and ION SIZE; MgO has higher lattice energy than NaCl because Mg²⁺ and O²⁻ have higher charges

title: Why Nonmetals Share Electrons (And How to Draw It)
subtitle: Chemical Bonding
overview: Chemical Bonding 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Resonance structures and delocalization

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: electron sharing and bond order
octet rule and formal charge

traps: Students minimize formal charges by guessing rather than calculating — formal charge = valence electrons − nonbonding electrons − ½(bonding electrons); the correct Lewis structure minimizes formal charge, and negative formal charge goes on the more electronegative atom

title: How Molecular Shape Controls Everything
subtitle: Chemical Bonding
overview: Chemical Bonding 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Bond angles and lone pair compression
Predicting polarity from shape

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: electron domain geometry vs. molecular geometry

traps: Students name electron domain geometry instead of molecular geometry — 'tetrahedral electron geometry with 2 lone pairs' gives a BENT molecular geometry; the exam asks for molecular geometry, which ignores lone pairs when naming shape

title: Why Some Molecules Are Polar and Others Aren't
subtitle: Chemical Bonding
overview: Chemical Bonding 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Bond polarity vs. molecular polarity
Vector addition of dipoles
Why CO2 is nonpolar despite polar bonds

sections.title: Why Some Molecules Are Polar and Others Aren't
traps: Students say any molecule with polar bonds is polar — CO2, BF3, and CCl4 have polar bonds but are NONPOLAR overall because the dipoles cancel due to symmetry; must assess both bond polarity AND molecular geometry

title: What Determines If a Solid Will Melt Easily
subtitle: Chemical Bonding
overview: Chemical Bonding 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: IMF vs. intramolecular bond strength
Why H-bonding makes water anomalous

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: LDF, dipole-dipole, H-bonding

traps: Students break intramolecular bonds to explain boiling — boiling/melting involves overcoming INTERMOLECULAR FORCES, not breaking covalent bonds; HF has stronger H-bonds than HCl despite F-H bond being weaker than nothing students expect

title: Why Metallic Bonds Explain All Metal Properties
subtitle: Chemical Bonding
overview: Chemical Bonding 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Electron sea model
Electrical and thermal conductivity explained by delocalized electrons

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: metals vs. ionic solids

traps: Students attribute metal conductivity to 'loosely held electrons' without specifying they are DELOCALIZED — ionic solids can conduct when melted or dissolved (ions move), but metals conduct in solid state because electrons move freely

title: Why the Mole Is the Chemist's Dozen
subtitle: Stoichiometry
overview: Stoichiometry 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Avogadro's number and the mole concept
Molar mass from periodic table
Converting between mass, moles, and particles

sections.title: Why the Mole Is the Chemist's Dozen
traps: Students divide by molar mass when they should multiply and vice versa — always set up dimensional analysis with units canceling; if you want grams → moles, divide by molar mass (g/mol becomes a divisor)

title: How to Balance Equations Without Changing the Chemistry
subtitle: Stoichiometry
overview: Stoichiometry 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Conservation of mass in chemical equations
Why subscripts cannot be changed to balance

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: polyatomics as units

traps: Students change subscripts to balance — H2O2 ≠ H2O; changing subscripts changes the SUBSTANCE; only coefficients in front of formulas can be adjusted; this is the most fundamental balancing error

title: How the Mole Ratio Connects Reactants to Products
subtitle: Stoichiometry
overview: Stoichiometry 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Mole ratios from balanced equations
Mass-to-mass stoichiometry pathway
Percent yield vs. theoretical yield

sections.title: How the Mole Ratio Connects Reactants to Products
traps: Students forget to use the mole ratio — they convert reactant to moles then convert directly to grams of product using the wrong molar mass; the mole ratio from the balanced equation MUST be applied between reactant moles and product moles

title: How to Find the Ingredient That Runs Out First
subtitle: Stoichiometry
overview: Stoichiometry 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Limiting reactant identification
Excess reactant calculation
Why comparing moles, not grams, identifies the limit

sections.title: How to Find the Ingredient That Runs Out First
traps: Students identify the limiting reactant as 'whichever has fewer grams' — you must convert to moles and compare using the STOICHIOMETRIC RATIO, not raw mass; a larger mass can still be the limiting reactant

title: Reading a Molecular Formula to Get Empirical and Molecular Formulas
subtitle: Stoichiometry
overview: Stoichiometry 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Percent composition from formula
Empirical formula from percent mass
Molecular formula = n × empirical formula

sections.title: Reading a Molecular Formula to Get Empirical and Molecular Formulas
traps: Students round elemental ratios too aggressively — if C:H:O comes out 1:2.67:1, multiply all by 3 to get 3:8:3 (not round 2.67 to 3); ratios ending in .33 or .67 signal × 3; .5 signals × 2

title: What Heat and Temperature Actually Measure
subtitle: Thermochemistry

objectives: Calorimetry setup and sign conventions

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: energy vs. average KE
q = mcΔT

traps: Students apply q = mcΔT using the wrong mass — in a coffee cup calorimeter, the mass is the SOLUTION (or water), not the substance being tested; and q_rxn = −q_cal (equal and opposite sign)

title: How to Calculate Energy Change in a Reaction
subtitle: Thermochemistry
overview: Thermochemistry 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
objectives: Standard enthalpies of formation (ΔHf°)

sections.title: Key concepts

terms.def: exothermic vs. endothermic
path independence of enthalpy

traps: Students apply Hess's Law by adding equations without reversing signs — when a reaction is REVERSED, ΔH changes sign; when multiplied by n, ΔH is multiplied by n; both manipulations must be applied simultaneously

title: Why Some Reactions Happen Spontaneously and Others Don't
subtitle: Thermochemistry
overview: Thermochemistry 단원의 핵심 주제예요. 아래 개념을 정확히 잡고, 빨간 함정을 피하는 데 집중하세요.
